_comment: Set bonus EP values. Per-spec overrides in 'spec_overrides' set a bonus to 0 if it doesn't apply to that build. Sources: Wowhead BiS guides, community theorycraft consensus.

2.desc: Reduces trap cooldown by 4 sec (minor PvE value)

4.desc: Kill Command makes your attacks ignore 600 armor for 15 sec. Keep 4pc until you have 4pc T5.

Beast Lord Armor._source: Wowhead/community: BM hunters keep 4pc through Phase 2. Only break for 4pc Rift Stalker (T5). ~80-100 AP equiv sustained = ~45 EP for BM. Lower for SV/MM since Kill Command is less central.

4.desc: +5% spell haste for 6 sec on harmful spell cast (uptime too low to be reliable)

2.desc: 5% chance on harmful spell to gain 92 spell damage for 10 sec (~25 EP avg)
Shadow Bolt and Incinerate have 5% chance to grant 135 shadow/fire spell power for 15 sec

4.desc: Corruption, Immolate, CoA ticks reduce cast time of next Shadow Bolt by 10% (DS/Ruin doesn't use these enough)

2.desc: Arcane Blast has 20% chance to grant 150 spell damage for 6 sec (~15 EP avg)

4.desc: Reduces mana cost of Arcane Blast by 100 (minor)

2.desc: Spell crit bonus +5% (Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, etc.)
